description: End a Preesy session now, so its files can no longer be printed or downloaded. Use the manage_token of that session from its create_print_session result earlier in the conversation. The manage_token is secret. A session that has already ended returns status expired.

manage_token.description: Secret returned by create_print_session. Keep it private. A label and PIN do not work here.

name: expire_print_session
title: Expire print session
